visualCharacteristics: Responsive grid of destination fare tiles: 2 columns on mobile, 4 on desktop. Each tile has a photo on top, a destination name, a green 'From SAR' price, and a small round-trip subtitle. Borderless tiles.
contentPattern: One row per destination. Each row: cell 1 = destination image, cell 2 = destination name + price + subtitle text.
usage: Destination fares grid, e.g. 'Best fares from Jeddah'.
